'''Chane''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]] she and a fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Desora]] were send by the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]] to follow a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to [[Rogun Matt'rik]]'s safe house on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The smuggler planned to kill Rogun for their past mis-dealings, unaware that they were mostly orchestrated by Kirill, aka the Voidwolf, whom the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] unwittingly helped. Chane and Desora interrupted the argument between the two and after revealing the deception via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], Kirill ordered the Sith to rid him of assets he no longer needed. However, the smuggler and Rogun decided to team up despite past differences and managed to defeat both of the Sith.
